info.description: Base scaffolding for Go APIs with Gin framework
info.title: Simple Arq Golang API

post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP code by email if it belongs to an active user. Always responds with the same generic message, to avoid leaking whether an email is registered.

parameters.description: Email to send the reset code to
parameters.name: body

post.description: Login with email and password. Returns access and refresh JWT tokens.

get.description: Returns all permissions for a user grouped by role and tier

post.description: Creates a new user account. Password is sent in the request body (min 8 chars).
Validates the OTP code sent via forgot-password and updates the user's password.
post.summary: Reset password using an OTP code

parameters.description: Email, code, new password and confirmation
parameters.name: body

get.description: Retrieve a user by providing either id or email as query parameter (not both).
get.summary: Get user by ID or email

post.description: Creates a new permission with name and optional description

get.description: Get a permission by its unique name
Get a permission by its ID

put.description: Updates a permission by ID with optional fields

delete.description: Soft deletes a permission by ID

post.description: Creates a new role with name and optional description

get.description: Get a role by its unique name
Get a role by its ID

put.description: Updates a role by ID with optional fields

delete.description: Soft deletes a role by ID

post.description: Creates a new tier associated with a role

get.description: Get a tier by its name
Get a tier by its ID

put.description: Updates a tier by ID with optional fields

delete.description: Soft deletes a tier by ID

post.description: Assigns a permission to a tier

delete.description: Soft deletes a permission assignment from a tier

put.description: Update user attributes (all fields except id, status). Email change requires X-Current-Password header.

post.description: Assigns a role to a user with optional tier (default: "base")

delete.description: Soft-deletes the active role assignment for a user, identified by role_id
delete.summary: Remove a role from a user

patch.description: Change the status of a user. Valid statuses: active, inactive, pause, blocked, suspended.

get.description: Returns pong if the server is running

role_id.description: ID del rol al que pertenece (requerido)

tier_id.description: ID del tier (opcional, default: "base" del rol)
